commits.subject: feat(download): let readers subscribe through the Substack embed
commits.body:
The success state now loads Substack's own embed iframe (created only after
a successful submit) with a plain link fallback, and no longer claims the
reader was subscribed via Substack.

commits.subject: fix(signup): drop the server-side Substack subscribe
commits.body:
The Worker's POST to cc4marketing.substack.com/api/v1/free?nojs=true is
redirected to the publication homepage (200 text/html) and never creates a
subscriber (diagnostic log, 2026-09-30). Remove it from /api/course-download
(with the temporary response log) and /api/subscribe. The Resend audience
step is unchanged.

commits.subject: feat(changelog): compute weekly entry range, filter, bump and modules in node
commits.body: Range starts at the newest changelog/v* tag, else the newest API entry date. Only feat, fix and content-path commits count. Claude copy is validated for dashes, hype words and bullet count.

commits.subject: feat(download): add the site-kick honeypot field and restore the Substack line
commits.body:
Hidden website field like the kit's BookSignupForm, sent with every submit; a
filled one gets the kit's fake success and never reaches the gateway. The
success copy mentions Substack again now that the route subscribes there.

commits.subject: feat(course-download): subscribe to Substack after live delivery, run list signups in waitUntil
commits.body:
After a live send the route now makes the same Substack request /api/subscribe
made (URL, payload, headers, never retried) next to the Resend audience step.
Failures log a status or error code through the kit allowlist logger, never the
address or response body. Both steps run in locals.cfContext.waitUntil (the
@astrojs/cloudflare ExecutionContext, confirmed present in the built worker) so
the reply goes out once the mail is sent; without a context they are awaited.

commits.subject: feat(download): post the form to /api/course-download with an idempotency key
commits.body:
One key per page load (site-kick form contract), resent on retry; in-flight
submits are ignored. Kit error codes map to the page messages; a simulated
answer says no mail was sent. Success copy drops the Substack claim, since the
new route does not subscribe to Substack. /api/subscribe stays for old pages.

commits.subject: feat(course-download): add reader to Resend audience after live delivery, carry subscribe mail copy
commits.body:
Route wrapper clones the request, runs the site-kick book handler, and only on a
200 ok non-simulated answer calls the kit's addToAudience (never flips an
unsubscribed contact). Honeypot and invalid email are screened again. Audience
errors are logged via the kit allowlist logger and never change the answer.
Book mail copy now matches the /api/subscribe mail (greeting, button label,
three-step quick start, signup footer).

commits.subject: fix(security): harden CMS and clarify AI authorship
fix(security): rate-limit and lock down /api/subscribe, drop /api/feedback, escape changelog + JSON-LD, add HSTS/CSP
commits.body:
- subscribe: fixed CORS origin, 415 on non-JSON, per-IP ratelimit binding, no upstream error leak
- remove unused /api/feedback (filed public GitHub issues with user emails)
- changelog worker: no default admin password, no CORS on /admin, escape admin table
- escape changelog fields rendered via innerHTML; jsonLd() helper escapes < in all JSON-LD
- middleware: HSTS + non-breaking CSP; strip off-origin ?redirect= on admin login

commits.subject: fix(seo): stop /modules/N/ soft-404 chain, add lesson schema, tighten meta, fix robots groups
commits.body:
- Lesson breadcrumbs linked /modules/N/ which 302'd to /404 (GSC soft 404 + page with redirect)
- /modules/N/ now 301s to hub anchor; unknown lesson slugs return a real 404
- 404 page noindex; LearningResource + ItemList JSON-LD; library/lesson title+desc lengths
- robots.txt: single shared group so named bots honour Disallow /api/; unblock /_astro/
- llms.txt: explicit lesson + library entry URLs
- middleware: exempt localhost from HTTPS redirect so preview works

commits.subject: feat(sitemap): auto-generate blog lastmod from D1 at build
commits.body:
Prebuild script syncs published posts (slug + lastmod) from Emdash D1 into
src/data/blog-sitemap-data.json, which astro.config reads for blog URLs and
<lastmod>. Removes the hardcoded blog list + date map. Committed JSON is a
last-known-good fallback so the build never fails if D1 is unreachable.

commits.subject: fix(seo): noindex /_emdash/* via _headers (asset layer)
commits.body:
The Emdash admin is served as a static asset, bypassing the Worker, so the
middleware noindex never runs for it. Set X-Robots-Tag at the assets layer so
Google drops the indexed /_emdash/admin/setup URL.

commits.subject: fix(seo): force https + noindex Emdash admin routes
commits.body:
http:// served 200 (protocol duplicate; http admin URL got indexed) — 301 to
https in middleware. Add X-Robots-Tag noindex on /_emdash/* so Google drops the
already-indexed CMS admin page (robots Disallow would block the recrawl).

commits.subject: feat(analytics): add self-hosted Plausible alongside Beam and GA4
commits.body:

until its Sep 2026 shutdown; GA4 kept in parallel during migration.

commits.subject: fix: add Module 3.1 to OG smoke-test expected list
commits.body:
The og:smoke check has a hardcoded EXPECTED_MODULES list; the new
Lesson 3.1 (merge-campaigns-safely) wasn't in it, so the build-time
OG image for that lesson flagged as an unexpected orphan and failed
CI. Caught by the actual deploy pipeline, not local build.

commits.subject: feat: Module 3.1 (merge campaigns) + case-study blog post + hello bar/banner update
commits.body:
New Lesson 3.1, "Send Merge Campaigns at Scale, Safely" — bulk, structured
merge-personalization and the full safe-send protocol. Paired with an open
starter kit (campaign-merge-kit) and a companion blog post walking through
a real send: the Gmail clipping bug, a Vietnamese-text encoding bug, a
wrong tracking-data claim caught on verification, and why a 100% open
rate from a list of banks isn't the win it looks like.

The former Lesson 3.1 (sigil capstone) is now 3.2 at the same URL. Hello
bar and floating banner now point at the new lesson. Course: 4 modules,
20 lessons.

Merged with the conc
